location.description: Finca Montezuma, Dolphin Bay, Bocas del Toro, Panamá
location.arrivalNotes: Reachable by boat from Bocas Town or Almirante. We can help arrange a boat — just ask.

description.en: Walk the cacao grove, see the harvest and fermentation, and taste 100% cacao paste straight from the farm.
description.es: Recorre el cacaotal, conoce la cosecha y fermentación, y degusta pasta de cacao 100% directa de la finca.
description.nl: Wandel door de cacaotuin, zie de oogst en fermentatie, en proef 100% cacaopasta rechtstreeks van de finca.

description.en: Hands-on bean-to-bar workshop: roast, grind, and mold your own chocolate, plus the full tasting.
description.es: Taller práctico del grano a la barra: tuesta, muele y moldea tu propio chocolate, más la degustación completa.
description.nl: Hands-on bean-to-bar workshop: brand, maal en giet je eigen chocolade, plus de volledige proeverij.

description.en: Tell us what you'd like to see — birds, the jungle trail, the chocolate kitchen — and we build the visit around it.
description.es: Cuéntanos qué te gustaría ver — aves, el sendero de selva, la cocina de chocolate — y armamos la visita a tu medida.
description.nl: Vertel ons wat je wilt zien — vogels, het junglepad, de chocoladekeuken — en we stellen het bezoek daarop samen.

faq.a: Closed shoes or rubber boots, insect repellent, water, and rain gear — this is rainforest. We provide everything for the tastings.
Yes — kids love the chocolate workshop. Children under 6 join free on the tasting tour.
Cash (USD) at the farm, or we can send a payment link for groups of 5+.
We don't use that label. It is 100% pure cacao paste, grown, fermented, and stone-ground here at the farm.
By boat from Bocas Town (about 45 min) or Almirante. We can connect you with trusted boat captains — ask us.

escalation.note: Human owner reachable via WhatsApp; Don Tuco hands off for complaints, pricing exceptions, groups over maxGroupSize, or anything he is unsure about.
